newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA TELECOM APPOINTS IPO COORDINATORS -SOURCES.
newsitem.headline: CHINA TELECOM APPOINTS IPO COORDINATORS -SOURCES.

text.p: China Telecom (Hong Kong) has made progress with its initial public offering plans with the appointment of Goldman Sachs and China International Capital Corp (CICC) as joint global coordinators, market sources said on Wednesday.
Bear Stearns and JP Morgan have been named joint financial advisors, the corporate finance sources added.
Officials at the investment banks were not immediately available to confirm the appointments.
China Telecom (Hong Kong), controlled by China's Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications, is expected to list in September, although a time schedule has yet to be fixed.
Market sources said the company, which hopes to raise US$2 billion through dual Hong Kong and New York listings, was likely to short list co-managers this week.

"As the issue is relatively huge in size, dozens of co-managers are expected to be included on the list and it is likely to be a record in Hong Kong," said one corporate finance source, who declined to be named.

Sources said China Telecom (Hong Kong) was expected to hold the cellular phone networks of Guangdong and Zhejiang provinces. Zhejiang province was estimated to have one million subscribers and Guangdong two million, accounting for about one-third of the nine to 10 million subscribers in China, one source added.

China Telecom (Hong Kong) is also expected to hold its parent China Telecom's 5.5 percent stake in Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd. China Telecom agreed in June to buy a 5.5 percent stake in Hongkong Telecom from Cable and Wireless Plc for HK$14.25 per share. Before the sale, Cable and Wireless held 59.2 percent of Hongkong Telecom.

China Telecom is controlled by Telpo Communications Development Ltd, a holding company of China's Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications. The company said in June it was studying a listing of its Hong Kong subsidiary but gave no indication of the size or timing of the issue.
